title: The reading structure of the Arazzo catalogue
description: Lives at `catalogue/chapters.yaml`. Every view of a result groups its rows by it: the chapters in reading order, the capability folders of each chapter as its bands, and each folder's BASE sections in reading order. A document named by no arm of `capabilities.yaml` is BASE and names one section of its folder with `x-veredictum-section` on its `info`; a document an arm names is OPTION and names none. `options` gives every option of `capabilities.yaml` its theme and tier. `validate` refuses a folder in no chapter or in two, a BASE document with no section or an unknown one, a section no document uses, an OPTION document with a section, an option with no placement, and a `spec-boundary` option whose citation names no `report`. No openEHR spec governs this; it is the instrument's own design.

formalism.description: Whether the views badge each case of the folder with the template formalism (ADL 1.4 or ADL 2) its setups upload. `validate` refuses a case of such a folder that uploads no template, or templates of both formalisms.

tier.description: `recommended`: support is a SHOULD, so declining it is recorded as advisory. `options`: a MAY, or behaviour the release leaves to the implementation. `spec-boundary`: an option only because the released text is defective, recorded as an upstream report its citation names.
